body.statement: In a quadratic-mean differentiable semiparametric model, the limiting law of any regular estimator of a pathwise differentiable scalar parameter is the convolution of the centered normal law whose variance is the squared norm of the canonical gradient with an independent remainder law; in particular, its convolution variance is no smaller than that squared norm.

source.locator: Sections 2--3, especially the semiparametric variance-bound characterization

attestation.note: The stable DOI and exact section locator are supplied in lieu of a verbatim source transcription; only the scalar regular-estimator variance lower bound is used.
